reading.body:
This record is an OpenStreetMap node in Wieliczka, Poland, tagged as a data center, with no power capacity listed and no confirmed operator.

The only substantive facts are location and naming. The node sits near Kraków, a Polish technology and outsourcing hub, 13.4 miles from Kraków John Paul II International Airport. The name DISKUS Polska and the word "Diskus" suggest storage or IT, and a website exists at diskus.pl, but the research note states that no operator site, press coverage, or Polish business registration could be confirmed because search quota ran out.

For AI infrastructure, the entry carries no usable capacity signal. A data center tag with zero megawatts and no operator tells you nothing about how much compute the site supports, whether it is a colocation hall, a corporate server room, or a single rack. The distinction matters because AI scaling is constrained by powered, cooled, connected floor space, and this record does not establish that any of it exists here.

What the data does not cover is nearly everything a reader would want. There is no verification that a facility operates at this location, no floor area, no grid connection, no commissioning date, and no parent company. Treat it as a candidate location worth checking, not as a confirmed data center.
